newsitem.title: INDIA: India RBI rupee convertibility report on Internet.
newsitem.headline: India RBI rupee convertibility report on Internet.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said it will publish extracts from a report on capital convertibility of the rupee on the Internet on Tuesday.
RBI said the extracts will be released at 1300 hours local on RBI's website http://www.reservebank.com.
S.S. Tarapore, chairman of the Committee on Capital Convertibility, will formally present the report to the RBI governor at noon, RBI said.
